scope: Systems, storage, backup and recovery, networking, privacy, remote access, virtualization, monitoring and hardware controls.
methodology: Every catalog record was checked against retrieved official project, developer or maintainer documentation. HTTP success alone was not accepted as feature evidence.

Licenses were checked against source license files, package declarations or explicit official product terms. Application licenses were not inferred from website footer licenses. Unreadable grants are labeled unverified.
Release activity is distinct from software stability. Feed timestamps may describe prereleases; passive or uncertain maintenance is called out.
Recommendations are conditional editorial fits based on documented capabilities and constraints, not comparative benchmark results. No installed application or hardware was tested.
Download URLs are official landing or installation pages, avoiding version-specific executable guesses. A reachable landing page is not a binary signature or malware verification.
Four vendor sites served shell proxy placeholder pages; official content was reviewed through the web research service. Such receipts preserve their different retrieval method.
Research review date follows the session local date; raw retrieval timestamps are UTC and may fall on 2026-11-15.

retrieval_receipts.review_summary: Dated 2026-11-12. Vagrant itself reaches end of life at the end of 2026; vendor maintenance and repository activity will end. MIT enables forks, with continued maintenance not established.

remaining_gaps: No direct installation, malware analysis, restoration test, VPN privacy audit or comparative benchmark was performed.
Exact application license grants remain unverified for FileZilla Client and Deja Dup because their relevant source endpoints were unreadable or unavailable.
GrandPerspective and Duplicity primary pages state GNU GPL but the exact version is left unverified.
Repository activity alone does not establish long-term project health; proprietary products without explicit dated activity retain unverified maintenance.
Additional discovery can cover firmware utilities, enterprise endpoint management, NAS appliances, specialist forensic suites and deeper accessibility requirements.
Vagrant community continuity after the announced end-of-2026 vendor end of life is unverified.
